COMPETITION_AND_INCLUSION_UNPROVEN.falsifier: Future-data leakage or unsupported claim of winning inclusion
COMPETITION_AND_INCLUSION_UNPROVEN.required: Decision-time competitor/inclusion evidence and calibrated capture estimates

DECISION_TIME_AVAILABILITY_UNPROVEN.falsifier: Any feature received only after the historical decision
DECISION_TIME_AVAILABILITY_UNPROVEN.required: Authenticated receive-time ledger from original observations

EXTERNAL_PRINCIPAL_AND_REPAYMENT_UNPROVE.falsifier: Insufficient principal, repayment shortfall or operator principal/collateral/guarantee obligation
EXTERNAL_PRINCIPAL_AND_REPAYMENT_UNPROVE.required: Admissible exact provider and atomic repayment cashflow including premium and every non-gas obligation

FULL_COSTS_AND_MONETIZABLE_ROUTE_UNPROVE.falsifier: Any omitted cost, unmonetizable inventory or nonpositive conservative net margin
FULL_COSTS_AND_MONETIZABLE_ROUTE_UNPROVE.required: Exact route and all swap/slippage/gas/MEV/funding/failure/infrastructure costs with realizable repayment and proceeds

INDEPENDENT_AUTHORITY_PENDING.falsifier: Self-certification, failed reproduction or material source mismatch
INDEPENDENT_AUTHORITY_PENDING.required: Separate authority reviewing exact producer/consumer commits, trees, input bytes and declared scope

NATIVE_GAS_FUNDING_UNAUTHENTICATED.falsifier: Budget breach, reused funding proof, insufficient native balance or stale/future funding witness
NATIVE_GAS_FUNDING_UNAUTHENTICATED.required: Authenticated wallet, native balance, acquisition cost basis, nonce exclusivity and gas reservation within cumulative MXN 2000

TOKEN_TRANSFER_BEHAVIOR_UNPROVEN.falsifier: Any unsupported fee, rebase, hook, upgrade or balance behavior invalidates the route
TOKEN_TRANSFER_BEHAVIOR_UNPROVEN.required: Pinned runtime/proxy state, transfer semantics and adversarial fork tests for each required underlying
